title: Looking for Someone to Blame
sentences: When people couldn't explain the plague, they looked for someone to blame.
Jewish communities were falsely accused of poisoning wells.
In Strasbourg, in February 1349, hundreds of Jews were murdered.
Many Jewish communities along the Rhine were destroyed.
Pope Clement the Sixth condemned the attacks, pointing out that Jews were dying of plague too.
Fear spread even faster than the disease.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
caption:
When people couldn’t explain the plague, they turned on their neighbors.
